datasets.title: States
datasets.description: Postal code, FIPS code, congressional district count and legislature names and sizes.
datasets.origin: Compiled by Election Wrld from Open States, congress-legislators and official election returns; see sources

datasets.title: Election calendar
datasets.description: Every regular general election 2026 to 2032, plus known specials, by office, state and district.
datasets.origin: State law, official election returns, Senate.gov

datasets.title: 2026 polls
datasets.description: VoteHub polls: generic ballot, Senate, governor, House and approval.

datasets.title: President by state, 1976 to 2024
datasets.description: Votes for the Democratic nominee, the Republican nominee and all others, by state and year.
datasets.origin: MIT Election Data and Science Lab (CC0)

datasets.title: Members of Congress
datasets.description: Current US House members by district and US senators by state.

datasets.title: State election offices
datasets.description: Each state's and DC's official election office: home page, official results page, voter lookup and registration links. Each link checked on the date shown.

datasets.title: Sources
datasets.description: Every source behind these tables, with its license and retrieval date.

datasets.title: Data notes
datasets.description: Known gaps, choices and caveats recorded while building each table.

datasets.title: US House results by state
datasets.description: Every House race 1976 to 2024 with candidates, votes and shares, keyed by district.
datasets.origin: MIT Election Data and Science Lab (CC0), with the House Clerk or FEC official count on rows that name it

datasets.title: US Senate results by state
datasets.description: Every Senate race 1976 to 2024 grouped by seat class.
datasets.origin: MIT Election Data and Science Lab (CC0), with the House Clerk or FEC official count on rows that name it

datasets.title: Governor results by state
datasets.description: Every governor general election on file, 1990 to 2025. Each race's source is named in the data notes.
datasets.origin: State election offices and the Cha, Kuriwaki and Snyder candidates file (CC0); see data notes

datasets.title: President by county, 2000 to 2024
datasets.description: County totals keyed by 5-digit FIPS code.
datasets.origin: MIT Election Data and Science Lab (CC0)

datasets.title: State legislative results by state
datasets.description: General and special elections for both chambers through 2025, keyed by OCD-ID.
datasets.origin: Klarner State Legislative Election Returns (CC0) through 2022. Later rows name their own source: state election offices, MEDSL or OpenElections, each under its own terms

datasets.title: State legislators by state
datasets.description: Current legislators keyed by OCD-ID. No addresses, phone numbers or emails.
